accountId.description: The account the changes were applied to.

oldState.description: The Principal state before this set, or null if the server cannot calculate it.

newState.description: The Principal state after this set.

created.description: Successfully created principals (typically empty — creation is server-managed).

updated.description: Map of successfully updated PrincipalId to the updated object (or null if unchanged properties are not returned).

destroyed.description: PrincipalIds that were successfully destroyed (typically empty — destruction is server-managed).

notCreated.description: Creation ids that failed, with a SetError.

notUpdated.description: PrincipalIds that failed to update, with a SetError.

notDestroyed.description: PrincipalIds that failed to destroy, with a SetError.
